items.name: Content Exporter
items.summary: Export posts, pages, and media as a downloadable ZIP archive.
items.description: Adds an admin plugin action that packages Postizer content, page files, media metadata, and media files into a single ZIP export.

plugins.name: Content Exporter
plugins.description: Export all posts, pages, and media into a downloadable ZIP archive.

items.name: WebDAV Backup
items.summary: Automatically back up posts, pages, and media to a WebDAV server.
items.description: Creates complete Postizer ZIP archives on a schedule, uploads them to WebDAV, and removes older backups according to the configured retention count.

plugins.name: WebDAV Backup
plugins.description: Back up all posts, pages, and media to WebDAV automatically.
